Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: six-frame 2D game-character movement sheet. Image 1 is the approved front-facing idle strip of the adult Medic Iona Vale; image 2 is her exact original front-facing reference. Keep the same adult face, short blonde hair, ivory hood and ragged ivory coat, dark trousers, brown boots and gloves, right-hip red satchel, small attached vial and single brass medical rifle. Keep the original right rear grip and left forward support grip, with both hands attached and the instrument held securely throughout.
Draw exactly SIX complete independently drawn poses, arranged as three columns and two rows, reading left to right then top to bottom. Show a short grounded step STRAIGHT TOWARD THE CAMERA: 1 stand upright in the original ready stance, 2 bend the knees slightly, 3 lead one foot forward in a compact front-facing step, 4 transfer weight forward, 5 plant and settle, 6 recover the original upright ready stance. The front of the hood, face and chest stay visible in every frame; do not rotate into either side profile. Keep one common adult character scale, natural lower height for bent-knee poses, a shared baseline in each row, small cloth movement and consistent equipment placement.
Match the restrained matte ink-and-gouache drawing of the references. Preserve practical costume details without adding ornament. Each complete body, both boots, satchel and the entire held instrument must fit inside its own roomy cell. Leave wide empty gutters and generous clear outer margins. The background is genuinely transparent RGBA, alpha zero everywhere outside each character. No scenery, floor, shadow, glow, haze, gradient, particle, border, grid line, text or number.
